glossary.definition: (1) "Licensing agency" has the same meaning as in section 4745.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 3707.511 - Concussion awareness, training and procedures in youth sports organizations.

glossary.definition: (2) "Licensed health care professional" means an individual, other than a physician, who is authorized under Title XLVII of the Revised Code to practice a health care profession.
glossary.source_title: Section 3707.511 - Concussion awareness, training and procedures in youth sports organizations.
